name: Milo's Tea Company, Inc.
old_description: Milo’s teas, lemonades, and fruit punch are made with high-quality ingredients and no preservatives for a delicious, homemade taste.
about:
Milo's Tea Company, Inc. operates from Bessemer, Alabama. For more than 80 years, the company has followed the philosophy of its founders, Milo and Bea Carlton, who believed in doing things the right way and never sacrificing taste. The business remains family-made, adhering to the original approach of using high-quality ingredients without preservatives.

The company produces a line of iced teas, lemonades, and fruit punches, all formulated to be 100% natural. Seasonal offerings such as Peach Sweet Tea join the core lineup. Production details such as facility size, headcount, or annual volume are not publicly disclosed.

Milo's beverages are sold through retail channels where consumers can locate products via a store finder. The brand also engages directly with fans through a dedicated community page and an online merchandise store offering apparel and drinkware.

The company's stated differentiation rests on a commitment to "no short cuts, no nonsense" — using only high-quality ingredients, avoiding preservatives, and maintaining a family-made process that aims to deliver a homemade taste.
